title: Static website files
summary: An Azure Storage static website uses an index document and an error document. It is a way to serve files, not an application backend.
introduction: An Azure Storage static website uses an index document and an error document. It is a way to serve files, not an application backend. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: An Azure Storage static website uses an index document and an error document. It is a way to serve files, not an application backend.

blocks.code:
Index document: index.html
Error document: 404.html
Content: compiled frontend files
blocks.title: Static website files

blocks.text: The index opens the site; the error document helps when a page is missing. A real site also needs correct routing and domain configuration.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Explain why asset paths must work after uploading.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Static website access has different settings from ordinary private blob access; check the official service guide.
For more detail later, use this [Microsoft Azure further reading](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/cloud-adoption-framework/ready/azure-setup-guide/).
